offering_description.value: Provides technologies for secure payment and automation (currency validation, cash handling and cashless payment hardware) and security and authentication technology for banknotes and products. Sells to retailers, banks, central banks, gaming and vending operators, and brand owners. Designs and manufactures the products and software itself.

primary_products.value: currency validators and recyclers; coin and cash handling devices; cashless payment terminals; banknote security features and authentication materials; electronic shelf labels

primary_services.value: maintenance and technical support; installation services; software and analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, banks, gaming and casino operators, vending and kiosk makers, brand owners; B2G: central banks and currency authorities

end_markets.value: retail; gaming and casino; banking and currency; vending and kiosks; transportation; brand protection

revenue_model.value: product sales: payment hardware, validators, recyclers and banknote security features; service fees: maintenance, support and installation; subscription: software and recurring service offerings; licensing or royalties: technology licensing for security features
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds payment and cash handling equipment from components, sold to retailers, operators and equipment makers; component supplier: supplies validators and security features to kiosk, gaming and vending OEMs and central banks

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: payment innovations, currency security and merchandising technologies sharing payment and authentication technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: to banks, central banks, retailers, gaming operators and OEMs; distributors / dealers: distributors and integrators for payment equipment

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: currency security work with central banks, product safety, export, payment standards and data privacy rules

notes: Segment details from general knowledge; some product lines such as electronic shelf labels may be less certain.
